summary: Keep correctness and performance evidence reproducible across hardware and software changes.
outcomes: Design semantic, sanitizer and hardware compatibility test layers.
Detect meaningful performance regressions without treating noise as failure.
sequence: Define operator contracts and representative input classes.
Add randomized and adversarial numerical cases.
Separate correctness CI from controlled performance runs.
Store artifacts and triage a simulated regression.

visual.question: Is this slower result a real regression or an incomparable run?
visual.interaction: Change workload/environment metadata and inspect confidence in the comparison.

practice.task: Create a CI plan for a small GPU library and replay a regression report.
practice.success: Tests include tails, dtype/layout cases, tool evidence and versioned benchmark artifacts.
